claim: An empty screen is a wrong reference for an XOR plotter that draws the frame it erases; check draw-only entries against a model of the figure.

evidence.text: An XOR plotter on an empty screen draws the frame it means to erase; the model of the figure is the reference and the draw-only entries check the model; that check found the game draws nothing for a figure whose bottom line is above line 31 (signed compare).
